honest: You download this roster plus a ~16KB .aarm speaker profile per seat. Plug the slot id into any LLM that can POST OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech. This page previews in the browser with Web Speech using that seat's pitch and line. Not a 7B. Not a celebrity. Not llama. Same prices as LucaVoice.
